entries.claim_ceiling: Published regional evidence for possible South African low-enthalpy geothermal anomalies. Does not establish a producible high-temperature reservoir, well productivity, electricity capacity, drilling cost, commercial project or bankable reserve.
limitations: This is a regional prospectivity study, not a modern national geothermal atlas or resource certification.
The authors explicitly call for new temperature measurements and structural, hydrogeological and economic studies.
Low-enthalpy direct heat and geothermal electricity are different use cases; this record does not demonstrate commercial power generation.
A geothermal gradient anomaly does not prove sustainable fluid production, permeability, reservoir temperature at depth or acceptable drilling economics.

Cross-reference modern borehole temperature, heat-flow, geology, faults, hydrochemistry and mine-water datasets without treating interpolated maps as field measurements.
